clean_source_blocks.text: A judge has declared a mistrial in the rape case against Harvey Weinstein, after the jury in New York said it was deadlocked and unable to reach a verdict. It marks the third time a New York jury has considered the case against the 74-year-old disgraced film mogul, who remains jailed on other charges. The month-long trial was centred around whether Weinstein raped aspiring actress Jessica Mann in a hotel room more than a decade ago. He was initially convicted of raping her, before the verdict was overturned. A judge declared a mistrial after a second trial last year. Dozens of women have come forward with allegations of sexual misconduct, including rape, against Weinstein since October 2017. He has consistently denied wrongdoing.
It marks the third time a New York jury has considered the case against the 74-year-old disgraced film mogul.

The judge in the rape retrial of Harvey Weinstein declared a mistrial after the jury could not reach a unanimous verdict in the closely watched #MeToo-era case that another jury failed to decide last year. After deliberating for about nine hours, the jury told the judge Friday afternoon that they would not be able to reach a verdict and that further deliberations would be fruitless. The judge said the trial would be rescheduled, but it was not clear when. The signs of stalemate emerged a few hours into the third day of deliberations. Jurors earlier in the day sent a note saying they “have concluded that they cannot reach” a unanimous verdict. Judge Curtis Farber instructed the group to continue deliberating. That's generally what New York judges do at least the first time a jury says it's stuck.

Harvey Weinstein's rape retrial ended in a mistrial Friday after the jury deadlocked in the closely watched #MeToo-era case that another jury failed to decide last year. While the former Hollywood mogul has been convicted of other sex crimes on two U.S. coasts and remains behind bars, the mistrial leaves the New York rape charge in limbo after three trials. Weinstein appeared expressionless as court officers ushered him out in his wheelchair. A majority-male Manhattan jury had been weighing whether Weinstein raped Jessica Mann, a hairstylist and actor. Weinstein's lawyers argued that the encounter was consensual. It happened in 2013 during a fraught relationship between the then-married Weinstein and the decades-younger Mann.

[Lähde: BBC World]
A judge has declared a mistrial in the rape case against Harvey Weinstein, after the jury in New York said it was deadlocked and unable to reach a verdict.

It marks the third time a New York jury has considered the case against the 74-year-old disgraced film mogul, who remains jailed on other charges.

The month-long trial was centred around whether Weinstein raped aspiring actress Jessica Mann in a hotel room more than a decade ago. He was initially convicted of raping her, before the verdict was overturned. A judge declared a mistrial after a second trial last year.

Dozens of women have come forward with allegations of sexual misconduct, including rape, against Weinstein since October 2017. He has consistently denied wrongdoing.

Manhattan District Attorney Alvin Bragg said in a statement that prosecutors are currently determining whether to try again in court.

"While we are disappointed that the proceedings ended with a mistrial, we deeply respect the jury system and sincerely thank all of the jurors for their time and dedication," he said.

He thanked Mann for bringing her allegation against Weinstein, adding: "We will consider our next steps in consultation with Ms Mann, and in consideration of Harvey Weinstein's pending sentencing" in a separate sexual assault case.

"As always, we will continue to prosecute crimes of sexual violence – no matter who the defendant is – in a survivor-centered manner that uplifts their voices in the pursuit of justice."

Lawyers for Weinstein said the outcome shows "how deeply public perception and prejudice surrounding Harvey Weinstein have become embedded in society".

"For some people, regardless of the evidence presented, saying 'not guilty' has become emotionally or socially impossible," they argued.

"The Manhattan District Attorney's Office should stop retrying the same case and focus its time and resources on the actual violent crime, chaos, and public safety issues impacting New Yorkers every day," the statement from his lawyers continued.

The decision on Friday by the majority-male jury in Manhattan came on the third day of deliberations.

On Friday morning, the jury passed the judge a note saying they "have concluded that they cannot reach" a unanimous verdict. The judge then ordered them to continue deliberating before later declaring a mistrial, saying it was "quite clear," that they were "hopelessly deadlocked".

Harvey Weinstein's rape retrial ended in a mistrial Friday after the jury deadlocked in the closely watched #MeToo-era case that another jury failed to decide last year.

While the former Hollywood mogul has been convicted of other sex crimes on two U.S. coasts and remains behind bars, the mistrial leaves the New York rape charge in limbo after three trials.

Weinstein appeared expressionless as court officers ushered him out in his wheelchair.

A majority-male Manhattan jury had been weighing whether Weinstein raped Jessica Mann, a hairstylist and actor. Weinstein's lawyers argued that the encounter was consensual. It happened in 2013 during a fraught relationship between the then-married Weinstein and the decades-younger Mann.

The signs of stalemate emerged Friday a few hours into the third day of deliberations. Jurors sent a note saying they "have concluded that they cannot reach" a unanimous verdict. Judge Curtis Farber instructed the group to continue deliberating. That's generally what New York judges do at least the first time a jury says it's stuck.

Jurors returned to their closed-door discussions for more than an hour before sending another note with the same message, adding: “We feel that no one is going to change where they stand.”

One juror, Josh Hadar, told reporters that nine people wanted to acquit Weinstein and three wanted to convict him.

Defence attorney Marc Agnifilo called it "a great day for our jury system."

A hearing was set for June 24 to learn whether prosecutors will choose to go to a fourth trial. District Attorney Alvin Bragg said he was disappointed with the result but "we deeply respect the jury system."

Bragg said his staff will consult Mann about another trial and also take into account what happens to Weinstein when he's sentenced in another case. Mann was not in court when the mistrial was declared.

payload.title: Harvey Weinsteinin raiskaussyytteen käsittely kariutui jälleen New Yorkissa
payload.summary: Newyorkilainen tuomari on julistanut Harvey Weinsteinin raiskaussyytettä koskeneen uudelleenkäsittelyn rauenneeksi, koska valamiehistö ei päässyt yksimieliseen ratkaisuun.
payload.content:
New Yorkissa tuomari on julistanut Harvey Weinsteinin raiskaussyytettä koskeneen uudelleenkäsittelyn rauenneeksi, kun valamiehistö ilmoitti jääneensä erimieliseksi eikä pystynyt saavuttamaan yksimielistä tuomiota. Kyseessä oli jo kolmas kerta, kun newyorkilainen valamiehistö käsitteli samaa syytettä 74-vuotiasta entistä elokuvatuottajaa vastaan.

## Valamiehistö ei löytänyt yksimielisyyttä

Oikeudenkäynti koski väitettä, jonka mukaan Weinstein raiskasi Jessica Mannin hotellihuoneessa yli vuosikymmen sitten. Mann on lähdeaineistossa kuvattu näyttelijäksi sekä kampaajaksi ja näyttelijäksi. Väitetty tapahtuma sijoittui vuoteen 2013.

Valamiehistö oli pohtinut ratkaisua noin yhdeksän tuntia. Se ilmoitti perjantaina iltapäivällä tuomarille, ettei yksimieliseen päätökseen päästäisi ja että neuvottelujen jatkaminen olisi tuloksetonta. Merkkejä umpikujasta oli tullut jo kolmantena neuvottelupäivänä, kun valamiehistö lähetti aiemmin samana päivänä viestin, jonka mukaan se ei katsonut voivansa saavuttaa yksimielisyyttä.

Tuomari Curtis Farber kehotti valamiehistöä vielä jatkamaan harkintaa ennen oikeudenkäynnin rauenneeksi julistamista. Lähdeaineiston mukaan New Yorkissa tuomarit toimivat yleensä näin ainakin ensimmäisellä kerralla, kun valamiehistö ilmoittaa olevansa jumissa.

## Syyte jää edelleen avoimeksi

Tuomarin päätös merkitsee, että New Yorkin raiskaussyyte jää toistaiseksi ratkaisematta. Oikeudenkäynti on määrä järjestää uudelleen, mutta uutta ajankohtaa ei lähdeaineiston perusteella ollut vielä selvillä.

Weinstein tuomittiin aiemmin Manniin liittyneestä raiskaussyytteestä, mutta tuomio kumottiin myöhemmin. Myös viime vuonna järjestetty toinen oikeudenkäynti päättyi tuloksettomana, kun toinen valamiehistö ei päässyt ratkaisuun.

## Weinstein kiistää väärinkäytökset

Weinstein on yhä vankilassa muiden seksuaalirikostuomioiden vuoksi. Lähdeaineiston mukaan entinen Hollywood-tuottaja on tuomittu muista seksuaalirikoksista Yhdysvaltain molemmilla rannikoilla, mutta tämä oikeudenkäynti koski erikseen New Yorkin raiskaussyytettä.

Puolustuksen mukaan Mannin ja Weinsteinin välinen kohtaaminen oli yhteisymmärrykseen perustunut. Syyttäjien väite oli toinen, ja juuri tämän kysymyksen ratkaiseminen jäi valamiehistöltä kesken.

Weinsteinia vastaan on lokakuusta 2017 lähtien esitetty lukuisia seksuaalista väärinkäytöstä koskevia väitteitä, mukaan lukien raiskausväitteitä. Hän on johdonmukaisesti kiistänyt syyllistyneensä väärinkäytöksiin. Uusi oikeudenkäynti tarkoittaisi, että sama syyte palaa jälleen New Yorkin oikeusjärjestelmän käsiteltäväksi.
summary_bullets: Tuomari julisti Weinsteinin New Yorkin raiskaussyytteen uudelleenkäsittelyn rauenneeksi valamiehistön erimielisyyden vuoksi.
Valamiehistö ilmoitti, ettei se pysty saavuttamaan yksimielistä ratkaisua.
Syyte koskee väitettyä raiskausta vuodelta 2013, ja tapaus on ollut valamiehistön käsittelyssä jo useita kertoja.

A judge has declared a mistrial in the rape case against Harvey Weinstein, after the jury in New York said it was deadlocked and unable to reach a verdict. It marks the third time a New York jury has considered the case against the 74-year-old disgraced film mogul, who remains jailed on other charges. The month-long trial was centred around whether Weinstein raped aspiring actress Jessica Mann in a hotel room more than a decade ago. He was initially convicted of raping her, before the verdict was overturned. A judge declared a mistrial after a second trial last year. Dozens of women have come forward with allegations of sexual misconduct, including rape, against Weinstein since October 2017. He has consistently denied wrongdoing.

The judge in the rape retrial of Harvey Weinstein declared a mistrial after the jury could not reach a unanimous verdict in the closely watched #MeToo-era case that another jury failed to decide last year. After deliberating for about nine hours, the jury told the judge Friday afternoon that they would not be able to reach a verdict and that further deliberations would be fruitless. The judge said the trial would be rescheduled, but it was not clear when. The signs of stalemate emerged a few hours into the third day of deliberations. Jurors earlier in the day sent a note saying they “have concluded that they cannot reach” a unanimous verdict. Judge Curtis Farber instructed the group to continue deliberating. That's generally what New York judges do at least the first time a jury says it's stuck.
